evals.name: misroute-init
evals.prompt: 项目已完成阶段 0。请用 Skill 1 处理「项目初始化」邮件（不应由 Skill 1 建项）。
evals.expected_output: 经 process_email 重定向到 Skill 0（routed_to_skill0），不新建采购包
assertions: process_result came from mail classification path
note tells user to use Skill 0 / project-init
no procurement package created by this mail

evals.name: rfp-forward
evals.prompt: 项目已完成阶段 0。请处理 RFP 转发邮件，初始化采购包 BMS。
evals.expected_output: 经 process_email 建包；Tracker / 卡片 / .eml 归档；卡片走 fulfillment-card 模板
assertions: process_result step is step1 and auto=true
milestone RFP 发出 is set
card HTML passes fulfillment-card template validation
请款申请.html looks like claim-form template

evals.name: po-payment
evals.prompt: 已有 BMS 包（技术方案已确认）。依次处理 Raise PO + 付款指示。
evals.expected_output: 经 process_email 写 PO/付款节点/金额；卡片与请款页为模板产物
assertions: process_result records Raise PO via pipeline (step3 auto)
process_result records payment terms via pipeline
milestone PO 已发起 is set
PO amount written to tracker or card (含税)
card HTML passes fulfillment-card template validation
请款申请.html looks like claim-form template
